title: Letter 1
author: Brennock Clerk (synthetic)
body: Dear Ada, the ledger arrived on Tuesday and the zero column was already filled.

title: Letter 2
author: Mireille Fixture (synthetic)
body: The clerk wrote that the sum would hold when they came to count it again.

title: Letter 3
author: Felbridge Office (synthetic)
body: We kept the books open all night; nobody could find the missing farthing.

title: Letter 4
author: Ada Fixture (synthetic)
body: Your letter about the carried zero made the whole office laugh at lunch.

title: Letter 5
author: Brennock Clerk (synthetic)
body: The auditors asked for the triplicate forms before the end of the month.

title: Letter 6
author: Mireille Fixture (synthetic)
body: I have copied the column twice and the second copy still disagrees with the first.

title: Letter 7
author: Felbridge Office (synthetic)
body: Please send the new primer; the children keep asking what the zero holds.

title: Letter 8
author: Ada Fixture (synthetic)
body: The rain ruined the outer pages, but the totals at the bottom survived.

title: Letter 9
author: Brennock Clerk (synthetic)
body: Mr. Varn signed the receipt without reading it, as he always does.

title: Letter 10
author: Mireille Fixture (synthetic)
body: Tell your sister that the shop on Crane Street now sells ruled paper.

title: Letter 11
author: Felbridge Office (synthetic)
body: The tally sticks from the old office were finally burned last winter.

title: Letter 12
author: Ada Fixture (synthetic)
body: Nobody in this town remembers who first painted the clock face blue.

title: Letter 13
author: Brennock Clerk (synthetic)
body: The new apprentice counts faster than any of us, though he hums while he works.

title: Letter 14
author: Mireille Fixture (synthetic)
body: I found your pencil notes in the margin and could not read a single word.

title: Letter 15
author: Felbridge Office (synthetic)
body: Our accounts balanced for the first time since the flood of the spring.

title: Letter 16
author: Ada Fixture (synthetic)
body: The postmaster refuses to stamp anything after four o'clock on Fridays.

title: Letter 17
author: Brennock Clerk (synthetic)
body: We should meet at the station café and settle the matter of the ledger.

title: Letter 18
author: Mireille Fixture (synthetic)
body: The inspector arrived early and counted the chairs before the money.

title: Letter 19
author: Felbridge Office (synthetic)
body: My hands are tired from writing the same figures in three different books.

title: Letter 20
author: Ada Fixture (synthetic)
body: Give my regards to the printer; his new type is wonderfully clear.

title: Letter 21
author: Brennock Clerk (synthetic)
body: The bank clerk insisted that every zero be written with a slash through it.

title: Letter 22
author: Mireille Fixture (synthetic)
body: A storm took the roof of the warehouse, and the inventory with it.

title: Letter 23
author: Felbridge Office (synthetic)
body: Mother says the old receipts belong in the attic, not on the kitchen table.

title: Letter 24
author: Ada Fixture (synthetic)
body: The schoolmaster drew a large circle on the board and called it nothing at all.

title: Letter 25
author: Brennock Clerk (synthetic)
body: We sold the last of the blue ink to the harbour office this morning.

title: Letter 26
author: Mireille Fixture (synthetic)
body: Every evening the night watchman reads the totals aloud to the empty hall.

title: Letter 27
author: Felbridge Office (synthetic)
body: The ferry was late again, so the weekly ledger travelled by cart instead.

title: Letter 28
author: Ada Fixture (synthetic)
body: Your cousin promised to mend the abacus before the market opens.

title: Letter 29
author: Brennock Clerk (synthetic)
body: I wrote the figures in red so that the director would notice the error.

title: Letter 30
author: Mireille Fixture (synthetic)
body: The cooperative now keeps its books in a cupboard that locks with two keys.

title: Letter 31
author: Felbridge Office (synthetic)
body: On Sunday the whole family gathered to count the coins from the jar.

title: Letter 32
author: Ada Fixture (synthetic)
body: The tax collector smiled for once when he saw the neat columns.

title: Letter with a quoted line
author: Ada Fixture (synthetic)
body:
He wrote: "Carry the zero."
Then he signed the "final" copy.

title: पत्र अनुपम
author: Brennock Clerk (synthetic)
body: अनुपम ने बही में शून्य को साथ ले चलने की बात लिखी और गिनती फिर से की।

title: दूसरा पत्र
author: Mireille Fixture (synthetic)
body: दुकान के खाते में हर शाम हिसाब मिलाया जाता है और शून्य सबसे पहले लिखा जाता है।

title: Letter with a vague date
author: Felbridge Office (synthetic)
body: The well was dug the year the bridge fell, or so the old ledger says.

title: Letter with a short date
author: Ada Fixture (synthetic)
body: Somebody scratched the year off the corner of this page long ago.

title: Letter
author: unquoted
body: English
cites: This row has one field too many because of the comma in its title.
